title: Execute Vulnerability Scans
objective: Run multiple specialized scans (e.g., network, package, configuration) against the host using industry-standard tools.
rationale: A single scan is insufficient; multiple tools are needed to cover different attack vectors (network, application, configuration) and provide comprehensive coverage.
expected_output: Raw scan results files containing identified vulnerabilities, severity ratings, and affected assets.
success_criteria: At least three distinct types of scans (e.g., network, package, configuration) are executed.
All raw scan output files are successfully collected and stored.
The scan process completes without critical tool failures.
